title: docs(skills): the automation skill's readonly-field callout states the limit a flow started from a button has

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`objectstack-automation` 技能里「写只读字段?设 `runAs: 'system'`」这段提示补了一句:按钮或动作不能让用户启动声明了 `runAs: 'system'` 的 `autolaunched` / `record_change` / `schedule` 流程,会回 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`;用户从按钮启动的流程要提权只有两条路,一是声明 `runAs: 'system'` 的 `screen` 或 `api` 流程,二是由用户身份运行的流程通过 `subflow` 节点调用提权流程。
- **为什么改**:lint 提示和 `os explain flow-update-readonly-field` 已经写明这个限制,技能是最后一处只给旧说法的地方。客户的 agent 照着技能把按钮启动的流程改成 `runAs: 'system'`,按钮一点就报 403。
- **风险与回滚**:只改技能文案和一个 changeset,不动代码。同文件删 7 处另有出处的内容来付 token:6854 → 6852,上限 6861 没抬。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看**:`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 第 164-168 行(新增的一句);第 170-171 行(「Elevate the write, not the flow」缩成一句,最大的一处删减);第 273-274 行(script 段删掉的尾句)。
- **两分钟验证**:运行 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,应看到 `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md 6852 / 6861 (-9)`。
- **需要你做的**:批准这个 Tier H PR(`skills/**` 需受管审批人批准),之后席位落地。

## What changes

**One sentence added** to the callout "Writing a `readonly` field? Set `runAs: 'system'`" in `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, § Failure routing & `runAs` (L164-168), as the callout's last sentence:

> A button or action does not let a user start an `autolaunched`, `record_change` or `schedule` flow declared `runAs: 'system'`: it answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, so for a flow a user starts from a button the elevated routes are a `screen` or `api` flow declared `runAs: 'system'`, or a user-run flow whose `subflow` node calls the elevated flow.

The words are those of `os explain flow-update-readonly-field` on `main` (`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`, the last paragraph of `FLOW_UPDATE_READONLY_FIELD_EXPLANATION`, landed by PR #32736): "does not let a user start an `autolaunched`, `record_change` or `schedule` flow declared `runAs: 'system'`: it answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`" and "for a flow a user starts from a button, the elevated routes are a `screen` or `api` flow declared `runAs: 'system'` …, or a user-run flow whose `subflow` node calls the elevated flow".

**Seven cuts from the same file** pay for it. Each row names the cut text and where its content still lives. Line numbers are on the base, `5fb79bc0`:

| # | Where | Cut | Its content still lives in |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | L165-168, callout "Elevate the write, not the flow" | "A `screen` flow stays `runAs: 'user'`; a step that must write a `readonly` field moves into a dedicated `runAs: 'system'` flow called from a `subflow` node" | the new sentence directly above it: "a user-run flow whose `subflow` node calls the elevated flow". The callout keeps its rule and its reason: "Prefer the `subflow` route — raising a whole `screen` flow silently elevates every other write in it" |
| 2 | L106, the `notify` section heading | "— the most-used node type" | a tagline that states no rule. No link in the repository targets this heading (the one in-repo anchor into this file is `#failure-routing--runas`) |
| 3 | L418, the start-node example | the comment "gates whether the flow launches on the event" | Valid-but-silently-wrong item 4: "`condition: …` parses, matches no row: the flow stages clean and never fires" |
| 4 | L87, `get_record` row | "(that name has no executor and throws)" | the same cell: "there is no `query_record` node" |
| 5 | L271, Valid-but-silently-wrong item 3 | "Keep data effects on the flow graph (visible, governed, build-checkable)" | the clause before it, "a later declarative node persists it", and the paragraph's opening, "it does NOT read/write the database" |
| 6 | L43, `schedule` row | ", see *Time-relative triggers*" | the pointer under Trigger Configuration (L429): "references/examples-flows.md § Time-relative triggers" |
| 7 | L42, `screen` row | "(wizards, forms)" | the skill description: "interactive screen flow / wizard"; and the `screen` node row (L98): "Display a UI form to the user" |

`.changeset/32832-automation-skill-readonly-button-limit.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with the same seven cuts and their other homes; it names cut 1 as the one rule relaxed (order → preference). Head `232ccaa4` changes only this changeset; `SKILL.md` is byte-identical to `cdf9a53a`, where the gates below ran.

## Tests

Skill prose and one changeset. No package code changes, so no test is added and no ablation applies.

Card Work 2, the skill's evals that grade readonly writes or `runAs` (`grep -n "runAs\|readonly" -r skills/objectstack-automation/evals`): `flows-triggers-approvals.json` evals at L6-13 (nightly `schedule` flow writing a readonly field, `runAs: 'system'`), L65 (branching `screen` flow, `runAs: 'user'`), L193-204 (identity writes refused under system), L320-327 (scheduled digest, `runAs: 'system'`) and L339-343 (`record_change` mirror stays `runAs: 'user'`), and `integrations-declared.json` L17-20 (scheduled connector sync, `runAs: 'system'`). Each still grades the rule the skill teaches: none starts an elevated flow from a button, and none expects the text a cut removes. No eval changes.

`packages/rest/src/meta-state-route-doc-spelling.test.ts` reads this SKILL.md (its state-introspection route line, which this diff does not touch): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/meta-state-route-doc-spelling.test.ts` on head `cdf9a53a`, "Test Files 1 passed (1) · Tests 8 passed (8)". `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`, not a derived family and run because cut 3 edits a fenced example: exit 0, "345 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)". `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs`: exit 0. `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0 (it does not ratchet `skills/**`).

## Acceptance notes

**The sentence is read off the code on `main` at `5fb79bc0`, not off the card's prose.**

- `flowStartRefusal` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-start-admission.ts`), rule 1: a caller that is not the system principal may not start a flow declared `runAs: 'system'` whose `type` is in `SELF_TRIGGERED_FLOW_TYPES` (`autolaunched`, `record_change`, `schedule`). The answer is `ELEVATED_START_REFUSAL`: status 403, code `PERMISSION_DENIED`, the same at the trigger routes, an action of `type: 'flow'` and a declared endpoint.
- `screen` and `api` are deliberately outside that set; an elevated one is gated by the flow's own `requiredPermissions`, which the skill's callout "Who may START a flow" already teaches ("Gate an elevated `screen` / `api` flow here").
- The lint fix line (`packages/lint/src/validate-readonly-flow-writes.ts`, `ELEVATED_BUTTON_ENTRY`) names the same two routes: "a 'screen' or 'api' flow", or a subflow node.

**Acceptance.** The callout states the limit (403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`) and both routes. `check:skill-docs` and `check:skill-refs` are green on this head.

**Deviations from the card's wording.**

1. The card's draft sentence names the routes only. The sentence here also names the three flow types and the 403, as the explanation does and as the order for this card asks.
2. Cut 1 rewords the callout "Elevate the write, not the flow" from an order ("A `screen` flow stays `runAs: 'user'`") to a preference ("Prefer the `subflow` route"). The explanation names an elevated `screen` flow as a legitimate route, and the callout "Who may START a flow" already tells the author how to gate one, so the order no longer matched the rest of the section. The reason the callout gives is unchanged.

**Same-file serial with PR #32839 and PR #32841.**

- No cut here is in either PR's diff (heads `a4cd80c8` and `752d4d53`), in the candidates listed for PR #32841, or in the passages earlier cuts name as their other home.
- Both PRs edit the lines of the readonly callout above the new sentence. The new sentence is appended under the callout's last line, which neither PR changes. Local trial merges of this head (discarded): with `a4cd80c8`, clean, 27427 bytes, 6852 tokens; with `752d4d53`, clean, 27436 bytes, 6854 tokens. The three hunks the two PRs conflict on with each other are unchanged by this head.
- This diff is net -9 bytes, so it takes no headroom from either PR in any landing order: the 126 bytes PR #32841 owes after PR #32839 becomes 117 after this one.

**Readings (`skills/**`).**

| | Before (`5fb79bc0`) | After (`cdf9a53a`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` lines | 467 | 469 |
| same file, bytes | 27434 | 27425 |
| same file, tokens (ceiling 6861) | 6854 (headroom 7) | 6852 (headroom 9) |
| bundle, sum of the 11 `skills/*/SKILL.md`, lines | 4604 | 4606 |
| bundle, sum of the 11 `skills/*/SKILL.md`, tokens | 58724 | 58722 |

No ceiling row moves. The new sentence is 357 bytes on five lines; the seven cuts remove 366 bytes and three lines. No line was re-wrapped to buy room. `skills/**` has no line ceiling (`check-skill-line-ratchet` covers `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`); the token ratchet is the budget here.

**Noted, not filed.**

- The Flow Types table's `api` row still says "a flow only ever started explicitly is `autolaunched`". That stays true for a `runAs: 'user'` flow; the new sentence covers the elevated case. carrier: none.
